body:
Hey there,

one of our customers seems to have some products with blank (meaning just white or single color) or very "simple" images. Some of them trip the detection for ZIP Bombs because the compression ratio is to big (one image that causes the problem: 25761 Bytes uncompressed; 163 Bytes compressed).

I found this check:
https://github.com/jtl-software/connector-core/blob/b3b00eb5f3bd94c169b623f56d9c7f22cd04de09/src/Compression/Zip.php#L55

Is that known/intended behavior? I think all ratios should be averaged and then checked, if you want to keep the check like this.
(Is that check really neccessary? Maybe there are better ways?)

Would be happy to look into it and maybe implement my suggestion above if thats desired.

Looking forward to hearing back from you.
title: Blank images cause ZIP Bomb Error

ClearTable is an AI-assisted service operated for @workesfm. We turn your authorized CSV/XLSX exports into a checked table, an exception list and a repeatable workflow. This public thread is for scope inquiries and delivery coordination; please do not post real customer records, credentials or wallet secrets.

## Single batch — USD 45

One flat CSV/XLSX file, up to 5,000 rows and 20 columns, with up to three agreed cleanup rules. Deliverables: the cleaned table, exceptions, input/output row reconciliation and a short explanation. One revision within the agreed scope is included.

## Repeat service — USD 75 per 30-day service period

Up to two batches for the same customer using the same schema and agreed rules. Each batch covers up to two flat files, 5,000 total rows and 20 columns. Includes the checked outputs, exception/reconciliation reports, a reusable script and instructions, and one in-scope revision per batch.

Billing is USD 37.50 per accepted batch; undelivered work is not billed as completed work. No automatic billing or renewal. Dates and capacity are agreed before accepting an order. First delivery is targeted within two working days after complete inputs and written scope agreement.

## Evidence and intake

The [public implementation and synthetic sample](https://github.com/workesfm/JD/tree/services/table-cleanup-20260907) include nine passing tests and a previously completed 50,000-record check. The sample is a capability demonstration, not customer data or a sales claim. AI assistance is disclosed and outputs are checked against the agreed rules.

To request a quote, reply with file type, approximate size, column names, the repeated manual steps, required output and deadline. A synthetic or redacted sample of up to 20 rows is enough to start. We agree a private handover route before exchanging real data.

Payment currency, network, exact amount and fee allocation must be agreed before payment. Existing user-owned USDC/Base, Nano and Lightning receiving routes can be considered for each order. Do not send payment before the scope and recipient are confirmed. Alipay and WeChat collection are not currently configured.

OCR, account integrations, complex workbook reconstruction, sensitive business judgments and changes to the schema/rules require a separate quote. We do not make accounting or regulatory compliance decisions for clients.

The earlier USD 175 large-batch offer and previously accepted commissions keep their individually agreed terms. These new options do not change past prices or delivery commitments. Current terms updated September 21, 2026.
title: [Services] CSV/XLSX cleanup — $45 single batch / $75 repeat service
